notes.title: Stream Animals - AFK Mode Update
notes.notes:
Hey Friends!

I appreciate you all who are still playing the game. Over the years I've received a ton of feedback about how people play it. I originally developed it as something you would play as your main game during a stream but most people do it as more of an AFK/break time game. I've decided to embrace that. I've simplified and sped up the modes to hopefully make it more fun. This will seem like a drastic change but hopefully everyone will enjoy it. 

Now instead of choosing a single mode, you start a session and choose what modes to play. It will randomly cycle through the modes until you end the session. You can then see results for each match and a total for the entire session. 

I'm also planning on adding more quicker modes to the game that you can put in your session rotations. More details on that to come soon.

Follow us on Twitter or join us on Discord to stay updated!

- Smash Bolt Games

notes.title: Update 19 - Leaving Early Access!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that Stream Animals is leaving Early Access! We would like to thank everyone who has supported us through the early stages of our game. The game will still be supported and we will be adding new content such as new themes, new events, and more animals! 

Our first Survival Season is ending on February 29th, season two will be starting soon after. 

Release Notes
New Map Layouts
There are 3 new map layouts for classic maps: Creepy, X, and Skull.

Patch Notes:
 Fixed: When making it to the finish line in Dash Mode, the animals would not stack correctly.


Follow us on Twitter or join us on Discord to stay updated!

- Smash Bolt Games

notes.notes:
This is a small update giving players better control over the time for each phase.  There are also a few fixes included to prepare for the introduction of Battle Mode. Battle mode will turn the animals against each other in a more PvP focused mode. There will be more details soon on the new game mode!

New Time Controls

 Reset Time - Resets the time to the default time for that phase.
 Add Time - Add 15 second increments of time.
 Subtract Time - Subtracts 15 second increments of time.
 End Timer - Skips to the end of the phase.
